column1: # bs-bidder reads two things from a parse: the device type, which it maps onto
# an OpenRTB device type, and OS.Name.StringTrimPrefix(), which it targets
# campaigns by. These rows pin both for every agent in the test table of the
# BrightMountainMediaInc fork, the version bs-bidder was built against, so that
# an upstream merge cannot change what bs-bidder sees without failing here.
# The expectations are that fork's own, with four corrected where it was wrong
# and this version is right: the ASUS Transformer TF101 is a tablet, and the
# Samsung and LG televisions run Tizen and webOS rather than plain Linux.
